units.summary: Adds a test-only struct type holding input, expected Quantity and expected canonical string. It replaces the anonymous table struct inside the old TestQuantityParse; no production code is affected.
units.headline: Add parseQuantityTestcase struct for shared quantity parse test table
units.reason: New test-only type that replaces an inline table struct; it cannot affect production behavior and adds no removed assertions.

units.summary: The inline parse table becomes a function returning a fresh slice, and each case now carries an expected canonical String() result. Tests and benchmarks share it, and the fresh slice avoids cross-test mutation. Existing inputs and expected Quantity values are unchanged.
units.headline: Turn quantity parse table into shared generator with expected strings
units.reason: Test-only data refactor that keeps all existing cases and adds string expectations, so it strengthens rather than weakens coverage.

units.summary: The benchmark now runs one sub-benchmark per quantity and uses b.Loop instead of a manual index loop. It only changes benchmark structure.
units.headline: Benchmark AsApproximateFloat64 per quantity using sub-benchmarks and b.Loop
units.reason: Benchmark-only restructuring that does not run in normal tests and cannot affect production code.
